consent.heading: Before we check your documents
consent.whatBody: 4 business documents: GST certificate, Udyam certificate, authorised signatory ID and address proof.
consent.keepBody: Only the details we read from them. The photos are deleted right after reading.
consent.howLongBody: Only as long as telecom rules require by law (currently {{days}} days), then deleted.
consent.rightsBody: Withdraw your consent anytime before your service is installed: your documents and details are deleted and the KYC stops. Once installed, telecom rules require us to keep these records.
consent.requiredHint: Tick the required items to continue.

GST_CERTIFICATE.title: GST certificate
GST_CERTIFICATE.hint: Photo of the full page, flat, in good light

UDYAM_CERTIFICATE.hint: Photo of the full page, flat, in good light

SIGNATORY_ID.hint: The whole card, with name and validity date clear

help.heading: Help
help.whenA: Each service has its own date, shown above. They count from the day your documents are verified, and the last one sets your activation date.
help.changeSlotQ: Can I change my installation slot?
help.changeSlotA: Yes. Use "Change slot" on this page any time before the installation.
help.holdQ: What if my order goes on hold?
help.holdA: This page explains why and what happens next. Nothing is lost, and the order continues from the same step.
